What it is

LedGo ERP, a Public Shop website, and a shop app

In the app's own project this is the "TMB Agro Industries" flavor of the same Android code that also builds the TMB Brows browser — the difference is only its settings.

LedGo ERP

Products, stock, prices, bills, customers and Online Orders — the owner's business system.

Public Shop website

TMB Agro Industries' own branded ordering site, reading its products and prices from the ERP.

Android shop app

Opens the Public Shop full screen, like an installed app — nothing else.

The ERP is the single source of truth: stock, prices and online orders live there. The Public Shop has no direct access to the ERP database — see how Public Shop connects to LedGo ERP →

What a customer can do

Browse, order, track — on the website, the app, or any browser

Browse & search

Categories and search, with a full product detail page: photos, price, pack size and stock.

Honest prices

Shop price and MRP shown with a real saving worked out on the tax-inclusive price. Sold-out items say so.

Add or Buy now

A plus/minus stepper on cards and product pages, or Buy now for one item without touching the bag.

Delivery or pickup

Rules set by the shop (for example by pincode); the order total is calculated by the server.

Track the order

A live order page, the invoice, and cancel while it's still allowed.

Their own language

English plus Tamil, Hindi, Kannada and Telugu.

These are the same Public Shop features shown in detail on the Public Shop page →

What the owner does

Everything still runs through LedGo ERP

Stock

Products, batches and stock levels; the shop shows only what can be sold online. Expired stock is never sold online.

Prices

The normal sales rate, and optionally a separate Online Rate for the website.

Online orders

New orders arrive with an instant alert. Confirm makes a normal ERP sales bill from the same series as the counter; Pack, send and deliver follow.

Delivery charge

Recorded as a separate ledger entry at hand-over, kept out of the GST bill.

Why a shop app

One site, nothing else

The shop app is the same Android code as TMB Brows, switched into app mode by its settings.

Only this siteIt opens one website and nothing else. It is not in Android's default-browser or "Open with" lists.
No browser interfaceNo address bar, tabs or menus; the status bar takes the site's colour.
Native pushOrder notifications arrive from the shop's own server, the normal Android way.
Installs like a normal appIts own name, icon and splash screen, found and opened from the home screen.
Nothing extraNone of the TMB Brows Tools, no profiles, none of their permissions — checked on the release build.
Changes without a new appThe shop's address, name, theme and permissions come from an online settings file.

Where the same shop also wants a general-purpose browser, TMB Brows is a separate app.

Questions

Good to know

What is TMB Agro Industries?

A shop set-up built by {{company.name}}: an agri-inputs business running on LedGo ERP, with a Public Shop website and a branded Android shop app.

Do I need the app, or does the website work alone?

The website works in any browser. The app is an extra: it opens only your shop, full screen, with notifications.

How do orders reach my stock?

Customers order on the Public Shop; the order arrives in Online Orders. When staff confirm it, it becomes a normal sales bill and stock reduces from the batches chosen.

Can I change prices or products later?

Yes, in the ERP. You can set a separate online rate if the website price should differ.

Does the shop app work like a browser?

No. It opens one website only and cannot be set as a default browser.

Can the app's address change without a new app?

Yes — it comes from an online settings file.

Which languages does the shop support?

English, Tamil, Hindi, Kannada and Telugu for the customer website.
